summary: Frontend-only test of PAUSE (Expo web preview) after restore + shared glass-3D category icon migration + reader scroll-snap rewrite. Home (/discover), Topics (/explore), Saved (/bookmarks), Profile and Reader (/deep-dive/sky-blue-sunset-orange) all render without runtime errors or red screens. The new GlassCategoryIcon (react-native-svg) is drawn on all 8 Home tiles, on the 12 Topics chips and the 'Any topic' banner. Category selection toggles on Home (home-cat-scienza shows selected ring) and Topics (chip-scienza selects). Bottom tab navigation switches routes correctly. Reader renders Intro + Start reading button (deep-dive-start), ScrollView (deep-dive-scroll) is present, scrolling updates header progress label from initial state to '4 OF 6'. No pageerror events and 0 console errors — only two benign React Native Web deprecation warnings ('textShadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents). Native scroll-snap gesture/spring feel is not verifiable on web, as noted by main agent.

react_native_issues.issue: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated on React Native Web. Use consolidated 'textShadow' style. Non-blocking warning, but should be cleaned up. Reference: shows up during app boot across screens.

props.pointerEvents is deprecated on React Native Web. Move to style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking warning. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/category-artwork.tsx:41 (uses pointerEvents prop) and other components.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Replace pointerEvents={'none'} prop with style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} in category-artwork.tsx and any other RN components to silence the deprecation warning on web.
(Optional/low priority) Replace textShadowColor / textShadowOffset / textShadowRadius style props with the consolidated 'textShadow' style to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: glass-category-icon.tsx and category-artwork.tsx are small, focused, memoised — good. Uses vector SVG so icons are crisp and offline (no remote images).

category-artwork.tsx uses boxShadow via inline style cast to any — this is a web-only CSS property; on native it will be ignored (acceptable trade-off for the web preview neon glow, but note it is not cross-platform).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL: https://preview-engine-6.preview.emergentagent.com — go directly to /discover to bypass onboarding (onboarding is shown only on cold open by design). Reader route to test scroll: /deep-dive/sky-blue-sunset-orange. Native scroll-snap/spring feel cannot be validated on the web preview — only crash-free rendering and progress-label update should be checked there.
